rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE DEPARTMENT OF OVERSEAS FILIPINO WORKERS (DOFW), DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFORE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Intends to create a separate Department which should provide immediate, prompt, and effective response to OFWs problems both local and abroad and that there should be an official OFW bank which shall address the OFWs financial needs.

Provides for the powers and functions of the Department, some notable ones, as follows:  Assess, review, harmonize and coordinate all OFW-related local policies and procedures and International agreements to ensure overall consistency and implementation of the national policies; Build a strong and harmonious partnership with foreign countries and the private sectors to formulate strategies and implement the same; Assist and provide technical expertise on the formulation of strategies and plans concerning OFW activities if needed.
rows.status: Substituted by HB05832

rows.abstract:
Aims to address widespread abuses and malpractices involving the use of PDAF committed by some NGOs, charitable institutions, and foundations that put honest-to-goodness organizations into disrepute.

Proposes to mandate the Securities and Exchange Commission to raise “red flags” concerning unethical practices of these dubious organizations: investigating their acts and practices when there exists probable cause to believe that they are committing or attempting or conspiring to commit, or participating in, or facilitating activities in violation of existing laws, rules, and regulations.

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO AMEND SECTION 2 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 1405 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS 'THE SECRECY OF BANK DEPOSITS LAW', EXEMPTING GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES FROM THE PROHIBITION AGAINST DISCLOSURE OF OR INQUIRY INTO DEPOSITS WITH ANY BANKING INSTITUTION AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: States that:  \"All deposits of whatever nature with banks or banking institutions are hereby considered as of an absolutely confidential nature and may not be examined, inquired or looked into by any person, government official, bureau or office, except upon written permission of the depositor, or in cases of impeachment, or upon order of a competent court in cases of bribery or dereliction of duty of public officials or in cases where the money deposited or invested is the subject matter of the litigation; OR WHEN THE DEPOSITOR IS AN ELECTIVE OR APPOINTIVE OFFICIAL OR EMPLOYEE OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES INCLUDING THE OFFICERS AND MEMEBERS OF THE AFP, THE PNP, AND ALL THE MEMBERS OF THE UNIFORMED SERVICES, AND OFFICERS AND EMPLOYEES OF GOCCs AND THEIR SUBSIDIARIES.
